notes.title: Update 7/21/2025
notes.notes: This update fixes several dialogue bugs and improves optimizations. A new option has been added to the pause menu of playable songs that gives an adjustable "Note Delay" feature. This feature provides a fix if hardware has caused the audio and gameplay to fall out of sync.

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes: [p]I've completed testing of A Chamber of Stars on a Steam Deck. The game runs smooth on the Steam Deck, plus the game looks and sounds great. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40465653/25742c7d190ca2b83c096a0b51bbca67a79ba3c3.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Image credit: Steam)[/p][p][/p][p]It is recommended to set the Steam Deck buttons to the following controls:[/p][p]R2/L2 to Space bar[/p][p]A face button to E key or left click[/p][p]B face button to Q key[/p][p]D pad to W/A/S/D[/p][p]Start to Esc key[/p][p][/p][p]With these settings both the exploration and rhythm game sections will be playable.[/p][p][/p][p]The controls can be changed in both the Steam Deck settings as well as the pop-up menu while launching the game.[/p]

notes.title: New and improved! The reworked demo for A Chamber of Stars
notes.notes:
As development gets closer to completion I wanted to provide a demo that would be a better representation of the final game. Available now, is the reworked demo for chapter 1-1 of A Chamber of Stars. This new version includes:

[list]
[*] Improved graphics/improved sound mixing/improved performance.
[*] Better balancing and changes to the mechanics in the rhythm game sections. 
[*] New animations/new places to explore/new npcs. 
[*] Lots of quality of life improvements.
[*] A new ending scene outside of the Anxiety realm.
[/list]

notes.title: Bugs, Errors, Questions, Suggestions? Let me know
notes.notes: A Chamber of Stars is a work in progress and though the game has gone through a bug testing session there are always issues that slip past. If you have encountered any bugs or glitches in the demo please let me know. I will be updating the demo regularly. I will also be accepting any concerns or suggestions you have of the game. The more feedback I get the better the full game will be. Thank you for trying out the demo.
